name: What is a distressed property sale?

mainEntity.name: What is a distressed property sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: A distressed property sale typically refers to a property being sold under duress, often due to foreclosure, short sale, or bank-owned (REO) status. These situations arise when homeowners face financial difficulties and can no longer meet their mortgage obligations. As real estate agents specializing in these transactions across Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties, we assist both buyers seeking value and sellers needing a swift resolution.
acceptedAnswer.description: A distressed property sale involves a property sold under financial duress, such as foreclosure, short sale, or as a bank-owned asset.
